narr: In the Glen Haven and Crystal Mountain areas heavy rain produced flash flooding. Radar estimated 0.50 to 0.75 inch of rain in 30 minutes. Miller Fork washed over Larimer County Road 43 at Streamside Drive near The Retreat, closing the roadway. Streamside Drive was damaged but passable. Black Creek Drive in The Retreat was damaged pretty significantly. Every stream crossing along Black Creek Drive was reportedly washed out. There was a 6-foot drop at the first stream crossing on that road. Buckhorn Creek washed over Wildsong Road, and Sheep Creek washed across LCR 44H with minor damage reported. Deer Path and Wildsong became impassable by vehicle.||In Morgan County, heavy rain from 1.5 to 3.5 inches produced flash flooding. A couple of county roads around Brush were flooded. One of those roads was completely washed out. The basement of a residence was also flooded.
ev: Flash flooding damaged roads around The Retreat, Glen Haven and Crystal Mountain.

Heavy rain from 1.9 to 3.50 inches was observed near Brush. Flooding was reported along County Road U, just west of Highway 71. A basement in the area also flooded. County Road 28, north of Brush, was completely washed out and underwater.
